lines.text: The LORD remembers Israel's love as a bride, when she followed Him in the wilderness and was holy to Him.
Israel's fathers followed worthless idols, and the prophets prophesied by Baal.
The LORD says to look at Cyprus and send to Moab, to see if a nation changed its gods.
The LORD says His people forsook Him, the fountain of living water, and dug broken cisterns that cannot hold water.
Young lions roared, and the LORD asks what Israel gains going to Egypt to drink the waters of the Jordan.
